_comment: ÐMP List — lean wire. The listed dog stays in the seller UTXO; this is a new inscription.
_doc: op:list proves seller currently owns inscription_id (address-match at confirmation). It MUST NOT spend the listed UTXO. psdt is a seller-signed SIGHASH_SINGLE|ANYONECANPAY fill template any venue can complete. Omit currency/chain/listing_type — they default.
_price_note: 500,000 DOGE in koinu (1 DOGE = 100,000,000 koinu). Always a string.
_fee_note: listing_fee_address is the payee. listing_marketplace is a label only.
_psdt_note: Seller signed input 0. Buyer adds payment inputs and broadcasts. Omit for hash-only / OTC lists (not portable Buy Now).
_indexer_checks: Verify seller is the current UTXO owner of inscription_id at list confirmation (address-match — do not require the list tx to spend the dog)
Default currency=DOGE, chain=dogecoin, listing_type=fixed_price when omitted
If psdt and psdt_hash both present, hash MUST match SHA-256 of decoded PSDT bytes
Monitor inscription_id UTXO — auto-invalidate when spent without a valid settle
If a newer list op exists for the same inscription_id, supersede this one
